name: plane-taskgraph
description: Structured task graphs in Plane: features as Modules, ordering as blocked_by relations, parallelism computed rather than stored.

interface.shortDescription: Design talk in, structured Plane task graph out
interface.longDescription: Skills for recording a design discussion into Plane as a dependency graph (Module per feature, blocked_by relations for ordering), and for reading it back to compute which work items can start in parallel right now.
defaultPrompt: 把刚才讨论的设计记到 Plane 里。
